title: tephrosia diversifolia
intro: Tephrosia diversifolia, commonly known as the Chittagong tephrosia or locally known as 'Chotki', is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its diverse health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to alleviate symptoms of various diseases, including fever, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Tephrosia diversifolia include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
